mn68:3.6: “Mendicants, those gentlemen who have gone forth out of faith from the lay life to homelessness in my name—I trust they’re satisfied with the spiritual life?”
mn68:3.8: For a third time, the Buddha spoke to the mendicants about those gentlemen:
mn68:3.9: “Mendicants, those gentlemen who have gone forth out of faith from the lay life to homelessness in my name—I trust they’re satisfied with the spiritual life?”
mn68:5.7: Anuruddha, are you not ones who have gone forth out of faith from the lay life to homelessness just like that?”
mn68:7.5: ‘The Realized One has not given up the defilements that are corrupting, leading to future lives, hurtful, resulting in suffering and future rebirth, old age, and death.
mn68:7.6: That’s why, after appraisal, he uses some things, endures some things, avoids some things, and dispels some things.’
mn68:9.2: ‘This one is reborn here, while that one is reborn there.’
